name: CineStream
description: One stop solution for Movies, Series, Anime, AsianDrama and Torrents (includes CineAnime: AniList + TMDB + AnimePahe). v560: fix the "first solve saves an invalid cookie, needs three solves" bug. The solver used to treat "a cf_clearance exists" as success, but Cloudflare can write the token while the challenge is still running, so the cookie that got saved was one the next request was challenged with. Both the visible and the invisible/headless solver now prove the minted cookie with one real request (carrying the WebView's own User-Agent, which cf_clearance is bound to) before saving it and reporting success; a rejected token is retried at most every 10s so the solver keeps running without hammering Cloudflare. All v559 behaviour retained: solver class renamed to com.megix.settings.CineStreamSolverUi so the APK's own com.megix.settings.SettingsWebView can never shadow it (the Android TV crash), every solver call guarded by a Throwable catch, invisible mode only falls back to visible at app open, kwik.cx challenges fail silently, pre-playback probe validates the mirror holding the cookie, isCookieValid retries transient interstitials, pre-purge clearance snapshot prevents stale cookie saves.
